dedupe_keys.name: random forest ssp population projection example code

description: The SSP gridded-population research team deposits example code for its random-forest population projection method on Figshare. The version 3 record contains a code_example.zip archive and describes predictions for 248 countries or areas, on approximately one-kilometre cells every five years from 2020 to 2100. The model constrains spatial estimates to national Shared Socioeconomic Pathway population totals and uses data-worldpop-global-gridded-population as a baseline. The code archive is publicly available and free under CC BY 4.0. It can help prepare future demand or exposure inputs for infrastructure-capacity simulations. A caveat is that the repository description does not provide an executable environment or disclose all archive components. Programming language, dependencies and internal example coverage were not independently verified, because the large archive was not downloaded. The deposit is therefore documented example code requiring further setup, not a verified ready-to-run service.
